parallax_scroll="no" wd_hide_on_desktop="no" wd_hide_on_tablet="no" wd_hide_on_mobile="no" css=".vc_custom_1766069319012{margin-bottom: 20px !important;}"]The journey of WoodMart Fragrances began in a small family workshop in Provence, France. Founded by master perfumer Louis Beaumont in 1987, our brand was born from a passion for nature’s raw beauty and the art of perfumery. Inspired by the rich scents of wood, earth, and blooming florals, Louis spent years perfecting his craft, blending rare ingredients to create signature fragrances. What started as a modest venture quickly grew into an internationally recognized brand, known for its commitment to quality, sustainability, and innovation.
